name: Sous Vide Corn on the Cob

ingredients.name: corn, still in the husk, both ends trimmed

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a water bath to 84°C (183°F) using a sous vide precision cooker. Place corn, butter, salt, and aromatics inside 1 to 2 vacuum-seal bags and seal bags. Add two extra seals on each end to ensure sticking.

Clip a heavy metal spoon or knife to the edge of each sous-vide bag with a heavy-duty binder clip to weigh the corn down. Place in sous vide cooker and cook for 30 minutes. Open bags, remove corn from husks, discard aromatics and husks, and serve corn, passing extra butter at the table.

description: Cooking corn sous vide is the best route to juicy, tender-crisp kernels packed with flavor.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Aromatics such as cilantro, scallion, garlic, or dried chiles, if desired

Notes: If adding aromatics to the bag, add them sparingly. A few sprigs of herbs or half a split dried chile should do.
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
